info.name: Vending machine
info.description: HTTP API of the vending machine. One folder per bounded context. Select the `vending-machine.test` environment, which sets `baseUrl`.

exec: pm.test('reports the app ok and each dependency', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'ok', checks: { database: 'ok' } }));
pm.test('responds 200 when every dependency is ok', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('reports the app ok and each dependency', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'ok', checks: { database: 'ok' } }));

pm.test('lists the products of the statement', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().products.map((product) => [product.selector, product.name, product.priceCents])).to.eql([['WATER', 'Water', 65], ['JUICE', 'Juice', 100], ['SODA', 'Soda', 150]]));
pm.test('tells whether each product is available', () => pm.response.json().products.forEach((product) => pm.expect(product.available).to.be.a('boolean')));
pm.test('lists the selectors of the products', () => pm.response.json().selectors.forEach((selector) => pm.expect(selector).to.be.a('string')));
pm.test('lists the cents of each coin', () => pm.response.json().coins.forEach((cents) => pm.expect(cents).to.be.a('number')));
